executor.limits_note: core v2: the Spec (phi over b or over a mutant) is a measurement harness, never deployed, so EIP-170 does not apply to it: runtime limit 1 MiB (pyrevm CfgEnv.limit_contract_code_size), initcode limit derived by revm as twice that (EIP-3860's 49152 lifted), deploy gas = the block gas limit (about 145 KB of runtime at 200 gas per byte). b and every mutant must still be deployable: runtime <= subject_runtime_limit (EIP-170), enforced by the core. Calls keep tx_gas.
